notes.title: FAQ
notes.content:
General Questions

What is Cuisine Royale?
 Cuisine Royale is a ‘battle royale’ shooter. Find out more information about the game on the official website or on the Cuisine Royale Steam page.

Is the game free to play or do I need a subscription?
 The game is free to play until at least the end of Early Access, and doesn’t require subscription. Those who would love to support the development of the game, can purchase ingredients to create masks, suits, pants and other cosmetic items, and a Season Pass, which will allow you to get more rewards and level up faster!

Do I need to register to play Cuisine Royale?
 To play Cuisine Royale you can use either your Gaijin.Net account or play via Steam.

What is the Gaijin.NET Agent and how can I automatically update the game?
The Gaijin.NET Agent is recommended for set up at first launch of the game. The Gaijin.NET Agent is harmless and safe. It tracks updates in Cuisine Royale and downloads them to the game to its actual version (as well as any other Gaijin games installed on a PC). You can always turn off Automatic updates in the launcher settings.
Steam players can update and launch the game directly from the Steam Library, without using the launcher and the automatic updater. Though, we still recommend the use of automatic updates, launching the game via the launcher. It will allow you to update the game to the actual version at any time.

Where can I find the system requirements?
The actual system requirements can be found in the ‘About’ page on the game website or on the game’s Steam page.

How can I change the language in the game?
You can switch the language in the Launcher or in the game settings (right click the game title in Steam library – Properties – Language) if playing via Steam.

Game questions

How many players can participate in one battle and what modes are available?
30 players take part in each session. Currently we have three modes available:

    SOLO – a deathmatch where each player fights for themselves.
    DUO – battles for 2-player squads.
    SQUAD – battles for 3-player and 4-player squads. You can also try yourself in these battles fighting alone or in a team of two players.


Can I play with friends?
Yes, you can find contacts in the game main menu, add other players to your friends list and invite them to join a squad to play together in DUO (2 players) and SQUAD (3-4 players) modes.

What are the minions for and why do they follow players?
In games where both first person and third person views are available, the latter gives an advantage. A player can spot an opponent from behind an obstacle, while the opponent doesn’t know he’s been seen by his adversary nearby. In Cuisine Royale each player has a minion, which carries a camera in third person view. The third person view camera-man reveals the location of a player when looking from a corner. So be on the lookout. If you notice a butterfly or a small helicopter suddenly appearing from nowhere – you are being watched. If you switch to first person view, your minion will land on your left shoulder (you can see it, using the mouse plus the ‘C’ key).

Can I choose a server to play on?
Yes, there are servers available for Europe, East Asia, Eastern Europe and North America.

Can payed items provide me with any gameplay advantages?
In the game shop you can purchase a Season Pass and ingredients to create cosmetic items. They do not give any gameplay advantages, neither do they improve any skills in the game.

Account security and forbidden game modifications

Does the game feature an anti-cheat system?
Yes, in Cuisine Royale we use the EasyAntiCheat system, which prevents unfair play and fraud. EasyAntiCheat follows a zero-tolerance strategy for unfair play in Cuisine Royale, and any account ban will be permanent.

notes.title: High cuisine seasons! Italian Weeks
notes.content:
https://youtu.be/BPR4vqmpDD0
Hello, gourmets!

You already know how to use utensils to attack your enemies and defend from gunfire - time to learn how to cook!

 High Cuisine seasons comes to Cuisine Royale!
 Earn special ingredients and utensils in battles and cook unique “dishes” that have the spirit of the traditional national cuisine of the respective nation. 


The first season is devoted to Italy - here we go with a hundred Italian recipes. 
 
These are not the familiar pizzas or pasta which already can be found on the battlefield, but more valuable game items: fancy pants, stylish tights, elegant or scary Venetian masks, stencils for provocative graffiti and magnificent gravestones. 

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989692/27d38005d7666bc00f23b90900b9a6e97a339e29.jpg
Players will go from an apprentice to a chef starting with simple recipes and moving forward to more complex ones. 

Cooking

You will need special ingredients to cook unusual dishes. There are standard ingredients such as “enemy tears” and rare, “reviews of a frightened critic” may be gained for completing daily tasks. More complex recipes will require specific utensils such as the deadly meat grinder that can be obtained for completing weekly tasks. Some recipes will also require a premium ingredient - during the Italian season it will be the “Godfather’s book of recipes” - it can be purchased from the in game store.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989692/91557b393516a3727cd97b296a86b852f465bc79.png
Items that were cooked with these recipes do not provide any game advantage, but are designed to emphasize their owners style and individuality.

Camera-man and an interesting 3rd person game view

In games that have both first and third person view, the latter gives specific in-game advantage. It allows you to watch your opponent entering cover, while they are unaware that they are being watched. 

Every player in Cuisine Royale now has a minion with a camera that can uncover the position of a player who is peeking around a corner. So if you see a butterfly or a drone - you should know that you are being watched.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989692/e75faaf1f90cc74e362033b3b675fb0f93b9300c.png

What’s new?

    Reworked game launching.
Now it doesn't have a separate lobby, it just has a single client. So you will be able to test out new upcoming customization features in future from here.
    Improved client performance.

Notice that you will load in to the game a bit faster!

    Redesigned UI in lobby.

Sounds

    Now you can choose one of the voices of different famous YouTubers (in the settings in the battle - sounds - player voice).
Upd.: Possibility to choose one of the voices of different famous YouTubers (in the settings in the battle - sounds - player voice) has been temporarily switched off.
Added better river sound.
Reworked fridge sound.
Location and physics changes:

Reworked Normandy map: added lots of fences, openable WCs, towers, water towers, fortifications.
We have added more stationary guns which will respawn for each battle in different places. Now each battle will be more unique.
Improved movement mechanics. There's still some work to be done, but movement should feel better now.
Reduced recoil reduction for Eagle eye glasses from 50% to 25%.

Weaponry

Added the M1921AC Thompson.
The fire rate of the M1A1 Thompson has been changed from 600 to 750 shots per minute.
The fire rate of the M50 Reising has been changed from 500 to 750 shots per minute.
Fixed damage reduction dependant on shooting distance for guns using .30-06 bullet (7.62x63 - Springfield).
Others

    Multiple crashes caused during loading/unloading a level have been fixed.
  The index 'currentWeaponSlotName' does not exist" bug has been fixed.

notes.content:

Good hunting!

notes.title: Update 0.0.8.96
notes.content:
Added leaderboards to game!

Leaderboards are separated by mode you are playing (Solo, Duo, Squad), they're sorted by Win and Kill ratings and you need 20 battles (and at least one victory in Duo/Squad) to be shown there.

notes.title: Updates 0.0.8.77 and 0.0.8.88
notes.content:
We've been cooking some stuff, which we're ready to deliver in update 0.0.8.77:

    Improved loading time for PCs with slow HDDs
    Fixed additional camera shake after shooting (desync)
    Fixed several situations when loot could be dropped in same spot after death
  Improved loading time for PCs with slow GPUs

notes.title: Update 0.0.8.34
notes.content: We've temporary removed leaderboards from game menu. We'll add them back with win rating leaderboard, which will encourage skill, instead of temporary luck.

notes.title: Update 0.0.8.13
notes.content:
Good day to the most accurate chefs of the planet!

We continue to develop the game further, and while the competition may be growing, our next set of moves are planned:


The ‘Leaderboard’ has been added to Cuisine Royale.

Now you will be able to know who the most dangerous cook in our kitchen is!
We have also made the following changes:

The network part of the   EasyAntiCheat integration has been improved. Earlier, in very rare cases, you had the chance to be banned to the Gulag due to a bad connection while loading;



And of course, we fixed several issues which would cause game crashes.

Thank you for being with us, and for your feedback and comments - it’s damn good to have you with us! We are working to make your gaming experience even better. Good hunting!

Click here for our Discord servers.

notes.title: Update 0.0.7.230
notes.content:
Have you been waiting for a CuisineRoyale update? We thought you were! So we have prepared something for you:

From now on, a wounded soldier will not die if he tries to quit smoking and replaces the cigar in his hand with any other item.
If you decided to spend your vacation in East Asia or you already live there, we have good news for you. We added an opportunity to choose servers from that region. A good ping can save the day.
You want to be certain whether you successfully added a marker to the map or not? We added a sound notification for it - now you can’t miss it!
We have also worked on the weaponry. After doing some (ahem) highly technical testing against bottles with an M1 Carbine, we thought it needed a wee increase in its rate of fire, so it now fires faster. We have also reduced the recoil for the PPD and PPSh and changed the spread pattern.

We are sure you will like the update. Write in the comments what you like the most.

notes.title: Update 0.0.7.209
notes.content:
Hello shooters and culinary experts!

 Before, you might have suspected other players in playing an unfair game so we added to Cuisine Royale the EasyAntiCheat.

This system will arrange its own hunt for dishonest players. The  recipe for a victory in the kitchen will be skill and only skill.

What else do you need for a good hunt? Of course good guns!
So we have added the following weapons to the game:

Soviet hand-operated machine gun DP-27
British submachine gun STEN Mk II.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989692/d4e1a24ab50c4958aae0965f42f62c4ab17f198c.jpg

We have also prepared other changes to improve the game:

Exiting from a car when the door is locked has been fixed. 
Now players will use the door to exit that isn’t locked and can be used. No more failures under the ground or in collision physics when leaving a car (subject to further testing).
The possibility of breathing under water when lying down has been fixed.
Display of other teammates on the map has been improved.
Display of grenade trajectories that "shone” through objects has been fixed..
Shadows on low graphic settings has been visually improved.

notes.title: Update 0.0.7.192
notes.content:
Hey there!

The process of uninstalling the game through Steam has been fixed!

We identified that our game was not uninstalling correctly from Steam, where it continued to update and remain on your hard drive even after an uninstall.

Thank you for your support! Play more and give us your impressions!

notes.title: Update 0.0.7.188
notes.content:
Greetings! Today we released an update that improved teamplay. Find these and other useful changes below.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989692/81e217229b9cfee30daa9b6c3d98d25baabf951e.jpg

Teamplay (DUO, SQUAD)

An option to mark specific points for squadmates on the map has been added.
Squadmates silhouettes are now outlined and you can see them through walls which helps team interaction and coordination.
A warning notification about a random squad in duo/squad mode has been added. If you join a squad-based battle without teammates the game will inform you and will suggest to play solo mode or will add you to a squad consisting of random players if possible.
Switching to spectator mode after character death is now faster.

Armament

StG 44 assault rifle added.

Graphics, physics, sounds

Fog visuals improved. Now it looks more realistic.
Some collision issues when a character could be stuck in a wall have been fixed.
A bug when you couldn't hear other players jumping has been fixed.

Other

Internet connection requirements have been reduced (less traffic).
Kill statistics no longer take MGs and vehicles into account.

Hi there!

    Church collision model has been fixed. No more spying or crashing through the walls, so thank you for promptly letting us know about this bug.
    Speaking of the church, we have also made a small repair in there. Check it out, and be sure to let us know if everything is OK.

notes.title: Update 0.0.7.116
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989692/127937f6f0a6c719db72cdd5e7bafdac44e23328.jpg

Good morning!
It’s time for an update, because we’ve fixed several bugs and made a few more useful changes.

The possibility of breathing in a car immersed in water has been fixed. It makes sense; not every average car’s glove box contains a rebreather.
A bug where it was possible to pass through the textures of pillboxes (or at least many of the causes of this bug) has been fixed.
Interaction between bullets and water has been added. Now the bullet will not be destroyed by entering the water, but will instead lose its energy depending on the thickness of the water and distance travelled.
The possibility of moving with a stationary machine gun has been fixed. Those guns really do weigh a lot in the end...
An incorrect spectator camera has been fixed (previously allowed flying over the map).
Mapping of the direction of squadmates on the map has been added.
A bug regarding the lack of debriefing for squads after battle has been fixed.
The names of the villages have been added to the map.
Several bugs leading to the “Connection to the server has been lost” message have been fixed.
Long game loading times have been fixed (or at least several bugs that would lead to that occurring).

Have a good hunting!

notes.title: Update 0.0.7.77: squads, graphics and more
notes.content:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32989692/9515c3a8cfb1026e56541df3f85dac9586555ab9.png

Hi there!

So, you wanted to be able to play in squads, right? Well, your time has come! We promised to roll out the ability to squad up for battles with your friends this week, and now, the update is out!

    Duos and squads have been added. Invite your friends and compile teams for strong victories.

Of course, we have also fixed some other bugs, and added other useful features as follows.

 The grouping of loot which has fallen from defeated enemies has been changed. Now you can find and collect their things much faster.
Anti-aliasing has been improved. 
The options to choose the quality of the ground surface and anti-aliasing has been added to the graphics settings.
Several bugs relating to the “Video driver stopped responding and was restored” notice have been fixed.
A bug "Level loaded without local player" has been fixed.

So, now you no longer need to write comments like “ALL WE NEED IS THE ABILITY TO DUO AND SQUAD!!!”, but instead, you can politely suggest other useful features =)

Thank you for supporting us! Be sure to continue playing and sharing with us, in the comments, how you like the “triple 7” update, because we carefully read all your feedback and take it seriously.
